```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_audits,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'on shelf') AS on_shelf_audits,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'empty') AS empty_audits,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'on shelf') / COUNT(*), 2) AS availability_pct
FROM store.shelf_audits
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND audit_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < '2026-07-01';
```

```sql
SELECT date, forecast_units_per_day, units_sold_from_daily AS actual_sold,
       (forecast_units_per_day - units_sold_from_daily) AS estimated_lost
FROM (
    SELECT f.date, f.forecast_units_per_day, d.units_sold AS units_sold_from_daily
    FROM store.forecasts f
    LEFT JOIN store.daily_sales d ON d.sku = f.sku AND d.date = f.date
    WHERE f.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND f.date >= '2026-06-01' AND f.date <= '2026-06-30'
) sub
WHERE status_empty = true;
```

```sql
SELECT sa.audit_ts::date AS empty_date, f.forecast_units_per_day
FROM store.shelf_audits sa
JOIN store.forecasts f ON f.sku = sa.sku AND f.date = sa.audit_ts::date
WHERE sa.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND sa.status = 'empty'
  AND sa.audit_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND sa.audit_ts < '2026-07-01'
ORDER BY sa.audit_ts;
```
